question: Which unit is used to measure the concentration of contaminants in soil and sediment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PPM**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PPM** stands for parts per million, which is a unit used to measure the concentration of contaminants in soil and sediment.
 
• This unit is commonly used in environmental science to quantify very dilute concentrations of substances.
